title: Login with valid credentials
steps: POST /auth/login with alice@example.com / Password123
expected: 200. Response has a token and the user's id, email and name, and no password data

title: Login failure does not reveal whether the email exists
steps:
1. Login with a wrong password for a real user
2. Login with an email that is not registered
expected: Both return 401 with the same message

title: Email is not case-sensitive at login
steps: Login as ALICE@EXAMPLE.COM

title: Register a new user
steps:
1. POST /auth/register with a new email
2. Call GET /me with the returned token
3. Log in with the new credentials
expected: 201 with a token; /me returns the new user; login works

title: Duplicate email is rejected, ignoring letter case
steps: Register with Alice@Example.com (already registered as alice@example.com)
expected: 409 Email already registered

title: Invalid email formats are rejected
steps: Register with: 'plain', 'a@b', '@b.com', 'a b@c.com', ''
expected: 422 for each

title: Password length boundary
steps:
1. Register with a 7-character password
2. Register with an 8-character password
expected: 7 characters: 422. 8 characters: 201

title: Name cannot be blank
steps: Register with a name made only of spaces
expected: 422, no account created

title: Protected endpoints reject missing, malformed and unknown tokens
steps: Call GET /me, GET /cart, GET /orders and POST /checkout with: no header, 'Token abc', 'Bearer' and 'Bearer not-a-token'
expected: 401 every time

title: Name length boundary
steps:
1. Register with a 101-character name
2. Register with a 100-character name

title: Logging out ends the session on the server
steps:
1. Log in
2. POST /auth/logout with the token
3. Call GET /me with the same token
expected: Logout succeeds and the old token is then rejected with 401

title: Password made only of spaces is rejected
steps: Register with a password of 8 spaces

title: Malformed email domains are rejected
steps: Register with a@b..c, a@.com, a@b.c. and a@b_c.com
expected: 422 for each

title: Add a product to the cart
steps: Log in, POST /cart/items {product_id: 5, quantity: 2}, GET /cart
expected: Cart has one line: Cotton T-Shirt, unit price 499, quantity 2, line total 998; subtotal 998

title: Adding the same product again increases its quantity
steps: Add product 5 x2, then product 5 x3
expected: One line with quantity 5, subtotal 2495

title: Out-of-stock product cannot be added
steps: Add product 8 (stock 0)
expected: 409, cart stays empty

title: Cart quantity cannot exceed stock, counting what is already in the cart
steps:
Product 10 has 2 units. 1. Add 3
2. Add 2
3. Add 1 more
expected: Step 1: 409. Step 2: 200. Step 3: 409 and quantity stays 2

title: Invalid quantities are rejected
steps: Add product 5 with quantity 0, -1, 1.5, 'abc' and null
expected: 422 for each; cart stays empty

title: Change the quantity of a cart line
steps:
With product 10 x1 in the cart: 1. PUT quantity 2
2. PUT quantity 3
3. PUT quantity 0
4. PUT quantity for product 1 (not in cart)
expected: 1: subtotal 1298. 2: 409. 3: 422. 4: 404. Quantity stays 2

title: Remove lines and clear the cart
steps:
With products 5 and 9 in the cart: 1. DELETE product 5
2. DELETE product 5 again
3. DELETE /cart
expected: 1: only product 9 left. 2: 404. 3: empty cart, subtotal 0

title: Each user has a separate cart
steps: Alice adds product 5. Bob views his cart, then tries to remove product 5
expected: Bob's cart is empty and his delete returns 404; Alice's cart is unchanged

title: Unknown product cannot be added
steps: Add product 999, and product 'abc'

title: Cart is kept between logins
steps: Alice adds product 5, then logs in again and views the cart with the new token
expected: The cart still has product 5

title: Cart requests with a missing or empty body are rejected cleanly
steps: With product 5 in the cart: PUT /cart/items/5 with no body and with {}; POST /cart/items with no body
expected: 422 each time; quantity unchanged

title: Successful checkout
steps: Cart: product 1 x2. POST /checkout with a valid card
expected: 201. Order is paid with subtotal 5598, discount 0, total 5598. Stock of product 1 drops from 12 to 10. Cart is empty

title: Checkout with a coupon
steps: Cart: product 12. Checkout with coupon 'welcome10'
expected: Order has discount 4299, total 38691 and coupon_code WELCOME10

title: Checkout with an empty cart
steps: POST /checkout with nothing in the cart
expected: 400 Cart is empty; no order is created

title: Declined card changes nothing
steps: Cart: product 7. Checkout with card 4000000000000002
expected: 402 Payment declined. No order, stock still 15, cart still has the item

title: Card number format is validated
steps: Checkout with: 15 digits, 17 digits, letters, empty, digits with spaces, and no card field
expected: 422 for each; no order is created

title: Invalid coupon at checkout stops the order
steps: Cart: product 7. Checkout with EXPIRED50, then with NOSUCH
expected: 400 each time. No order, stock and cart unchanged

title: Coupon minimum is checked again at checkout
steps:
1. Cart ₹1,798 (products 3 and 9); FLAT200 validates
2. Remove product 9 (cart ₹1,499)
3. Checkout with FLAT200
expected: Checkout returns 400; the discount is not given below the minimum

title: A failed checkout does not take stock for the other items
steps:
1. Bob puts product 10 x2 in his cart
2. Alice puts product 5 x1 and product 10 x2 in hers
3. Bob checks out
4. Alice checks out
expected: Alice gets 409. Product 5 stock is still 50 and her cart still has both lines

title: Simultaneous checkouts never oversell
steps: Product 10 has 2 units. Six users each put 1 in their cart, then all six check out at the same moment
expected: Exactly 2 orders succeed (201); the other 4 get 409; stock ends at 0, not negative; no server errors

title: Submitting checkout twice creates one order
steps: Cart: product 7. POST /checkout twice in a row
expected: First: 201. Second: 400 Cart is empty. One order; stock 14

title: Two checkout requests for the same cart create one order
steps: One user has product 5 x1 in the cart. Send 8 checkout requests for that user at the same moment. Repeat 5 times
expected: Each time exactly one request returns 201; the rest are refused; one order is created and stock drops by 1; no server errors

title: Card number must use the digits 0 to 9
steps: Checkout with 16 Arabic-Indic digits (٤١١١١١١١١١١١١١١١) and 16 full-width digits
expected: 422; no order is created

title: Shipping details are stored with the order
steps: Cart: product 5. POST /checkout with a card and a shipping object (name padded with spaces). GET the order. Also GET /shipping/options
expected: 201. The order returns the same shipping details with the name trimmed. Options list India, 36 states and territories, and a shipping fee of 0

title: Invalid shipping details stop the order
steps: Cart: product 5. Checkout with, one at a time: bad email; blank name; blank address line 1; blank city; state 'Atlantis'; PIN '1234', '012345', '5600011', 'abcdef'; country 'Nepal'; a 201-character address line; a missing field
expected: 422 for each. No order is created, stock and cart are unchanged

title: An order cannot be placed without a delivery address
steps: Cart: product 5. POST /checkout with a card but no shipping object
expected: 422; a shop cannot deliver an order that has no address. No order is created

title: Percentage coupon
steps: Cart: Laptop Pro 15 (₹42,990). Validate WELCOME10
expected: Discount 4299, total 38691

title: Coupon code ignores letter case and surrounding spaces
steps: Validate '  welcome10 ' with product 12 in the cart
expected: Accepted as WELCOME10

title: Flat coupon needs its minimum order value
steps:
1. Cart ₹1,499 (product 3): validate FLAT200
2. Add product 9 (cart ₹1,798): validate FLAT200
expected: 1: 400 with the minimum stated. 2: discount 200, total 1598. (Exactly ₹1,500 cannot be reached with the seed prices)

title: Expired, disabled and unknown coupons are rejected with a clear reason
steps: Validate EXPIRED50, DISABLED20 and NOSUCH
expected: 400 each, with messages: Coupon has expired / Coupon is not active / Coupon not found

title: Percentage discount is a whole number of rupees and never more than the stated percentage
steps: Cart ₹499 (product 5). Validate WELCOME10 (10% = ₹49.90)
expected: Discount is 49 or 50 and subtotal - discount = total

title: Coupon cannot be applied to an empty cart
steps: With an empty cart, validate WELCOME10
expected: 400, since there is nothing to discount

title: Order list shows only my orders, newest first
steps: Alice places two orders, Bob places one. Each calls GET /orders
expected: Alice sees her two with the newer first; Bob sees only his

title: Order detail adds up
steps: Place an order for product 6 x3 with WELCOME10, then GET /orders/{id}
expected: One line: Denim Jacket, 2199 x 3 = 6597. Subtotal 6597, discount 659, total 5938; total = subtotal - discount

title: Another user's order cannot be seen or cancelled
steps: Alice places an order. Bob calls GET and POST cancel on its id
expected: 404 for both; the order stays paid

title: Cancelling an order returns the stock, once
steps: Order product 1 x3 (stock 12 to 9). Cancel it. Cancel it again
expected: First cancel: status cancelled, stock back to 12. Second cancel: 409 and stock stays 12

title: Unknown and malformed order ids
steps: GET /orders/999 and /orders/abc; POST /orders/999/cancel

title: Order records when it was placed
steps: Place an order and read created_at
expected: A UTC timestamp within the last minute

title: A cancelled order's stock can be bought again
steps: Order all 2 units of product 10, cancel, then order 2 again
expected: The second order succeeds

title: Cancelling the same order from several requests at once returns the stock once
steps: Order product 1 x3 (stock 12 to 9). Send 6 cancel requests for it at the same moment. Repeat 3 times
expected: Each time exactly one cancel succeeds, the rest get 409, and stock is back to 12, not higher

title: Catalogue lists all products with complete data
steps: GET /products
expected: 200 with 30 products; each has id, name, category, price, mrp, discount_percent, rating, reviews, stock, in_stock

title: Search matches part of the name in any letter case
steps: GET /products?q=RUNNING and ?q=shoe
expected: RUNNING: products 1, 2, 3. shoe: products 1, 2, 3, 4

title: Category filter agrees with the category counts
steps:
1. GET /categories
2. For each category GET /products?category=<slug>
3. GET /products?category=nonsense
expected: Each list has exactly the count from /categories and only that category; unknown category returns an empty list

title: Price range limits are inclusive
steps: GET /products?min_price=1499&max_price=1499, then min_price=1500&max_price=1898
expected: First: only product 3 (₹1,499). Second: empty

title: Minimum price above maximum price
steps: GET /products?min_price=5000&max_price=100
expected: 200 with an empty list

title: Every sort option orders the list correctly
steps: GET /products with sort = price_asc, price_desc, name, rating, discount
expected: Lists are ordered by that field; all 30 products are still present

title: Availability filter
steps: GET /products?in_stock=false, then in_stock=true
expected: false: only product 8. true: 29 products, none with stock 0

title: Invalid query parameters are rejected
steps: GET /products with sort=bogus, min_price=-1, max_price=abc, limit=0, limit=101, in_stock=maybe
expected: 422 for each

title: Discount shown matches list price and selling price
steps: For every product compare discount_percent with (mrp - price) / mrp
expected: discount_percent is the percentage rounded to the nearest whole number, for all 30 products

title: Unknown and malformed product ids
steps: GET /products/999, /products/0, /products/abc

title: Search treats % and _ as ordinary characters
steps: GET /products?q=% and GET /products?q=_
expected: %: only the two products whose specs really contain a % sign (5 '100% cotton' and 26 '70% cocoa'). _: nothing. Neither acts as a wildcard

title: Search is safe against SQL injection
steps: GET /products?q=' OR '1'='1 and q="; DROP TABLE products;--
expected: 200 with an empty list; the catalogue is intact afterwards

title: Search ignores spaces around the search text
steps: GET /products?q=%20shoes%20 (a space before and after)
expected: Products 1, 2, 3, 4

title: Filters combine, and limit caps the list
steps: GET /products?category=sports&max_price=2000&sort=price_asc, then add limit=2
expected: Products 28, 3, 27 in that order; with limit=2: 28, 3

title: Catalogue data is sane
steps: Check every product
expected: price > 0, price <= mrp, stock >= 0, rating between 0 and 5, in_stock matches stock

title: Search finds products by part of a word in the name, category or specs
steps: GET /products with q = mob, MOB, amoled, run sh, red lip, mob zzz
expected: mob and MOB: the 3 mobile products (9, 11, 15), found through the category. amoled: product 11, found through its specs. 'run sh': the 3 running shoes. 'red lip': product 20. 'mob zzz': nothing, because every word must match

title: Search suggestions
steps: GET /products/suggest with q = mob, ph, m, (empty), zz, %%, and q=sho&limit=2; then limit=0 and limit=21
expected: mob: category Mobiles (3 products) and products 9, 11, 15. ph: products whose name has a word starting with 'ph' come first (9, 15), then other matches (11, 14). One character or empty: no suggestions. zz and %%: no suggestions. limit=2: two products but total 5. limit 0 or 21: 422

title: The data reset endpoint is not open to anyone
steps:
Place an order, then POST /test/reset: 1. with no key
2. with a wrong X-Reset-Key
3. with the right key
expected: 1 and 2: 403 and the order still exists. 3: 200 and the data is back to the seed state

title: A user cannot act on another user's cart or order by guessing ids
steps: Alice has product 5 in her cart and one order. Bob tries PUT and DELETE on product 5 in 'his' cart and reads order ids 1 to 3
expected: Bob gets 404 everywhere; Alice's data is unchanged

title: Markup in a name is stored and returned as plain text
steps: Register with the name <script>alert(1)</script> and read /me
expected: 201; /me returns exactly the same text as JSON (the page is responsible for showing it safely)

title: Very large numbers never crash the server
steps: Use the number 10^30 as: product id, order id, min_price, max_price, limit, cart product_id, cart quantity, cart PUT/DELETE id
expected: Each request gets a 4xx answer (404 or 422 or 409). None returns 500

title: Reset returns everything to the seed state
steps: Register a user, place an order, leave an item in a cart, then POST /test/reset
expected: Stock is back to seed values; the new user, all orders, carts and old tokens are gone; seed users can log in

title: Health check and error format
steps: GET /health; GET /products/999
expected: Health: 200 {status: ok}. Errors are JSON with a 'detail' field

title: Home page shows banners, product strips and all categories
steps: Open the home page
expected: 4 banners, 3 product strips with 8 products each, 11 category tabs with 'For You' active

title: Banner carousel controls
steps: On the home page: click next, click previous, click the third dot
expected: The highlighted dot follows: 2nd, then 1st; the third dot becomes active after clicking it (on a wide screen it may stop at the last scroll position)

title: Category tab filters the catalogue
steps: Click the Books tab, then the Toys tab
expected: Title and results match the category (2 products each) and only that tab is highlighted

title: Header search
steps:
1. Search for 'running'
2. Search for 'zzzz'
3. Search for spaces only
expected: 1: 3 products and a 'Results for' title. 2: '0 products' and a no-results message. 3: all 30 products

title: Filters work, are kept in the address, and can be cleared
steps:
1. On All products set Category Sports, Max price 2000, Sort low to high, Apply
2. Reload the page
3. Click Clear
expected: 1: 3 products, cheapest first, address contains the filters. 2: same results and the filter fields still show the values. 3: 30 products

title: Product card shows price, list price, discount and stock
steps: On All products look at Smartphone X1 (id 11) and Bluetooth Speaker (id 8)
expected: X1: ₹49,999, struck-through ₹55,999, '11% OFF', '9 in stock', button enabled. Speaker: 'Out of stock', button disabled

title: Product page
steps:
1. Click 'Smartphone X1' in the list
2. Open /#/p/8 (out of stock)
3. Open /#/p/999
expected: 1: name, ₹49,999, 11% OFF, 9 in stock, Mobiles link. 2: Out of stock, quantity and button disabled. 3: 'Product not found' message

title: Adding to cart while logged out asks for login, then returns
steps: Logged out, open product 10, set quantity 2, click Add to cart; log in
expected: Login page with 'Please log in first.'; after login the same product page is shown again

title: Login and logout
steps:
1. Log in with a wrong password
2. Log in correctly
3. Log out
expected: 1: 'Wrong email or password' under the password field, still on the login page. 2: header shows Alice. 3: header shows Login / Sign Up

title: Show and hide password
steps: On the login page type a password and click the eye button twice
expected: The password becomes readable, then hidden again

title: Remember me
steps:
1. Log in with Remember me unticked and open the shop in a new tab
2. Log out, log in with it ticked, open a new tab
expected: 1: the new tab is logged out. 2: the new tab is logged in as Alice

title: Sign up
steps:
1. Type passwords 'abc', 'Abcdef12', 'Abcdef12!xyz' and watch the meter
2. Enter a different confirm password and submit
3. Fix it and submit
4. Log out and sign up again with the same email
expected: 1: Weak, Medium, Strong. 2: 'Passwords do not match' under the confirm field. 3: logged in under the new name. 4: 'This email is already registered. Log in instead' under the email field

title: Sign-up shows a plain message under every field that is wrong
steps: Open Sign Up and click Create Account with every field empty. Then type 'ab' as the password
expected: Four messages at once, each under its own field: 'Enter your full name', 'Enter your email address', 'Create a password', 'Enter your password again'. The cursor moves to the first wrong field. No technical text anywhere and nothing in the top banner. The password message changes to 'Password must be at least 8 characters' while typing

title: A name containing HTML is shown as text, not run
steps: Sign up with the name and look at the header
expected: The header shows the name as typed; no image element is created and no script runs

title: Cart and Orders need a login
steps: Logged out, open /#/cart, then /#/orders; log in
expected: Each time the login page with 'Please log in first.'; after login the Orders page opens

title: Expired session is handled
steps: Log in, end the session on the server (POST /auth/logout with the same token), then open the Cart
expected: Login page with 'Your session has ended. Please log in again.'; header shows Login / Sign Up

title: Cart badge counts units, on every page
steps: Log in. Add product 5 from the list twice and product 9 once. Visit home, a product page and the cart
expected: Badge shows 1, 2, then 3 and stays 3 on every page; 'Added to cart.' is shown after each add

title: Cart page: change quantity and remove
steps:
Cart has product 5 x1 and product 10 x1. 1. Set product 5 to 3
2. Set product 10 to 5
3. Set product 5 to 0
4. Remove product 10
5. Remove product 5
expected: 1: line ₹1,497, subtotal ₹2,146. 2: 'Only 2 in stock' under that row's quantity, which goes back to 1. 3: 'Quantity must be at least 1' under that row's quantity, which goes back to 3; totals unchanged. 4: subtotal ₹1,497. 5: empty-cart message, badge 0

title: Coupons on the cart page
steps:
Cart: product 3 (₹1,499). 1. Apply EXPIRED50
2. Apply FLAT200
3. Apply welcome10
4. Click Remove on the coupon
expected: 1: 'Coupon has expired' under the code field. 2: a message about the ₹1,500 minimum under the code field (and 'Enter a coupon code' if it is empty). 3: discount −₹149, total ₹1,350, 'Coupon WELCOME10 applied.' 4: discount −₹0, total ₹1,499

title: An applied coupon is dropped when the cart falls below its minimum
steps: Cart: products 3 and 9 (₹1,798). Apply FLAT200 (total ₹1,598). Remove product 9
expected: The coupon is removed with a message saying why; total is ₹1,499 with no discount

title: An applied coupon survives a page refresh
steps: Cart: product 3. Apply WELCOME10 (total ₹1,350). Reload the page
expected: The coupon is still applied and the total is still ₹1,350

title: Checkout: payment step and placing the order
steps:
Cart: product 7 with WELCOME10. Proceed to checkout, fill shipping, continue. 1. Continue with card '123'
2. Use 4000000000000002, continue, place order
3. Use '4111 1111 1111 1111', continue, place order
expected: 1: 'Card number must be 16 digits (you entered 3)' under the card field, still on Payment. 2: back on Payment with 'Payment declined. Try another card' under the card field; cart unchanged. 3: order page 'Order #1', paid, total ₹1,800, 'Order placed.', badge 0

title: Orders list and cancelling an order
steps: Place an order for product 10 x2, open Orders, open the order, click Cancel order, then open product 10
expected: List shows the order as paid; after cancel the status is cancelled, the Cancel button is gone, and product 10 shows '2 in stock' again

title: Opening an order that does not exist
steps: Log in and open /#/orders/999
expected: 'Order not found' message

title: Browser Back and Forward buttons
steps: Home, click Books, click the first product, press Back twice, press Forward
expected: Back: Books list, then home. Forward: Books list again

title: Pages fit a phone screen
steps: At 375 px width open home, All products, a product page, (logged in) the cart, checkout and orders, then login and sign up
expected: No page scrolls sideways

title: Browser tab title names the current page
steps: Open home, then a product page, then the cart
expected: The tab title changes with the page: 'Practice Shop', 'Smartphone X1 – Practice Shop', 'Cart – Practice Shop'

title: The chat assistant is hidden while it is switched off
steps: Open the home page (server started without AGENT_ENABLED)
expected: No 'Shopping assistant' button and no chat panel are visible

title: Automation ids are unique on each page
steps: On home, All products, a product page, login and sign up, collect every data-testid outside repeated product cards, table rows and banner controls
expected: No id appears twice, so a test can address each control without ambiguity

title: Checkout page layout and order summary
steps: Cart: product 5 x2 and product 9 x1 with WELCOME10. Click Proceed to checkout
expected: Step 1 Shipping is active. Email is pre-filled with the account email, country is India. Summary lists both items, subtotal ₹1,297, shipping ₹0, discount −₹129, total ₹1,168

title: Shipping form shows a message under every field that is wrong
steps:
On the Shipping step: 1. Clear the email and click Continue with everything empty
2. Type a bad email
3. Try PIN codes '12a', '1234' and '012345'
4. Fill everything correctly and continue
expected: 1: six messages at once, each under its own field (email, name, address, city, state, PIN); address line 2 has none; cursor in the email field. 2: 'Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com'. 3: 'PIN code can contain digits only', then 'Enter a valid 6-digit PIN code' twice. 4: each message disappears as its field is corrected, and the form moves to Payment

title: Review step shows what was entered, and Edit goes back without losing it
steps: Fill shipping and card 4111111111111111 and reach Review. Click Edit on the address, change the city to Mysuru, continue to Review again
expected: Review shows name, both address lines, city, state, PIN, country, email and 'Card ending 1111'. After the edit the form still holds the other values, the card is still filled, and Review shows Mysuru

title: The order keeps the delivery address
steps: Place an order through checkout and open the order page
expected: The order page shows a 'Deliver to' block with the name, address, PIN and email that were entered

title: Save this information for next time
steps:
1. Order with the box ticked, add another item and open checkout
2. Order again with the box unticked, add another item and open checkout
expected: 1: the shipping form is pre-filled with the saved address. 2: the form is empty again (email shows the account email)

title: Checkout needs a login and a non-empty cart
steps:
1. Logged out, open /#/checkout
2. Log in with an empty cart and open /#/checkout
expected: 1: login page. 2: sent to the cart with 'Your cart is empty.'

title: Checkout total follows the cart
steps: At the Payment step, go Back to Cart, change product 5 from 1 to 3, and proceed to checkout again
expected: Summary total is ₹1,497 and the shipping details typed earlier are still filled in

title: Product page: breadcrumb and 'More in this category'
steps: Open Smart Watch (id 13). Read the breadcrumb and the 'More in Electronics' strip. Click Laptop Pro 15 in the strip. Then open Mystery Novel (id 29)
expected: Breadcrumb reads Home > Electronics > Smart Watch. The strip lists the 4 other electronics products, not the Smart Watch itself. Clicking opens that product. Mystery Novel shows exactly 1 related book

title: Page headers and empty states on the inner pages
steps: Logged in with nothing in the cart: open Cart, then Orders. Add product 5 x2 and product 9, open Cart. Open the Sports category
expected: Empty cart and empty orders each show a message with a button that leads to the home page. The cart header shows '3 item(s)'. The Sports header has an 'All products' button that shows all 30 products

title: Suggestions appear while typing in the search box
steps: On the home page type 'm', then 'mob'. Read the list. Then type 'zzzz'. Then clear the box
expected: One letter: no list. 'mob': a Categories row 'Mobiles' (3 products), product rows Phone Case, Smartphone X1 and Budget Phone M2 with prices, and 'See all 3 results'. 'zzzz': 'No products match'. Empty box: the list closes

title: Choosing a suggestion with the mouse
steps: Type 'mob' and click the Mobiles category row. Type 'sma' and click Smartphone X1. Type 'mob' and click 'See all'
expected: Category row: the Mobiles page with 3 products. Product row: the Smartphone X1 page. See all: results page for 'mob' with 3 products. Each time the list closes and the search box is emptied

title: Using suggestions with the keyboard
steps: Type 'mob'. Press Down twice, then Enter. Type 'mob' and press Enter without choosing. Type 'mob', press Escape. Type 'mob' and click elsewhere on the page
expected: Down twice highlights the first product (Phone Case) and Enter opens it. Enter without a choice runs the search (3 products). Escape closes the list and keeps the text. Clicking elsewhere closes the list

title: Suggestions keep up with fast typing and fit a phone screen
steps: Type 'mobiles' one letter at a time without pausing. Then at 375 px width type 'sho'
expected: The list ends up showing matches for 'mobiles' only (no leftovers from 'mo' or 'mob'). On the phone the list stays inside the screen

title: Filter fields are aligned
steps: Open All products at 1366 px. Measure every field in the filter panel (search, category, min price, max price, availability) and the Apply button
expected: All fields are the same height. Search, category, availability and Apply share the same left and right edges. Min and max price sit on one row, are the same width, and together span the same edges

title: Price range filter and quick price buttons
steps:
1. Min 500, Max 1000, Apply
2. Min 2000, Max 100, Apply
3. Clear, click 'Under ₹500'
4. Click 'Under ₹500' again
5. Click '₹10,000 +'
expected: 1: 6 products, all priced ₹500 to ₹1,000, address has both values. 2: 'Maximum price cannot be less than the minimum price' under the price fields and results unchanged. 3: 6 products, the button is highlighted, Max shows 499. 4: all 30 products, nothing highlighted. 5: 4 products, Min shows 10000

title: Dropdown filters apply at once, and active filters can be removed one at a time
steps: On All products choose Category Sports (no Apply click), then Sort 'Price: low to high', then set Max 2000 and Apply. Remove the price tag, then the category tag
expected: Choosing Sports shows 5 products straight away and a 'Sports' tag. Sorting reorders at once and keeps the category. With Max 2000: 3 products and tags 'Sports' and 'Up to ₹2,000'. Removing the price tag: 5 products, still sorted. Removing the category tag: 30 products and no tags; 'Clear all' is hidden

title: Filters on a phone
steps: At 375 px width open All products, tap 'Show / hide', choose Availability 'Out of stock'
expected: The panel starts collapsed so products are visible first; the button opens it; choosing a filter shows 1 product with an 'Out of stock' tag, and the panel stays open. Nothing scrolls sideways

title: A field is checked as soon as the customer leaves it
steps: On Login: type 'alice@' in the email and press Tab. Correct it to 'alice@example.com'. Click into the password field and out again without typing. Click Login with both fields empty
expected: Leaving the email shows 'Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com' under it with a red border; the message disappears while the address is corrected. An untouched empty field shows nothing until Login is clicked; then 'Enter your email address' and 'Enter your password' appear under their fields

title: Quantity on the product page is checked at the field
steps: Logged in, open product 10 (2 in stock). Add with quantity 0, then empty, then 1.5, then 5, then 2
expected: 'Quantity must be at least 1', 'Enter a quantity', 'Quantity must be a whole number', then 'Only 2 in stock', each under the quantity field with nothing added to the cart. Quantity 2 is added: badge shows 2, 'Added to cart.' appears and the field message is gone

title: Sign-up rules are reported one field at a time with the right wording
steps: On Sign Up enter, leaving each field with Tab: name of spaces only; email 'a@b'; password of 8 spaces; confirm 'different'. Then change the password to 'Abcdef12' and the confirm to 'Abcdef12'
expected: Name: 'Enter your full name'. Email: 'Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com'. Password: 'Password cannot be only spaces'. Confirm: 'Passwords do not match'. After the password and confirm are corrected both messages disappear

title: Filter price fields are checked at the field
steps: On All products: Min 800, Max 300, Apply. Then change Min to 100
expected: 'Maximum price cannot be less than the minimum price' under the price fields and results stay at 30. After Min becomes 100 the message disappears; Apply then shows the 2 products priced ₹100 to ₹300

title: The first click on a submit button is never lost
steps: On Sign Up type 'sangamesh@' as the email and 'abc' as the password, then click Create Account with the mouse while the cursor is still in the password field. On Login type 'alice@' and click Login the same way
expected: The single click submits the form: all four sign-up fields show their messages (name, email, password, confirm). On Login both fields show a message. A message appearing under the field being left must not move the button away from the click

title: Pages load without console errors or failed requests
steps: Open the home page, a category page, a product page, the login page and the sign-up page, watching the browser console and network
expected: No console errors and no failed requests on any of them. The tab shows the shop's icon and GET /favicon.ico returns 200

title: Placing an order lands on its order page and empties the cart
steps: Cart: product 9 x1. Open /#/checkout, fill shipping, continue, card 4111111111111111, continue, place order, then open the cart
expected: Page URL is /#/orders/1 with 'Order placed.', 'Order #1', status paid, total ₹299, badge 0. The cart page shows 'Your cart is empty.'

title: After a second order the Orders link shows it first
steps: Order product 5 x1, then product 9 x1. On the second order's page click Orders in the header
expected: Orders page shows '2 order(s)'; the first row is order #2 (₹299, paid), the second row is order #1 (₹499, paid)

title: Quantity 1 carries through from the product page to the order
steps: Open product 5 (Cotton T-Shirt, ₹499), add it with quantity 1, open the cart, check out with card 4111111111111111, then open product 5 again
expected: Product 5 starts at '50 in stock'. Cart row, checkout summary and order page all show quantity 1 and ₹499; order subtotal ₹499, discount −₹0, total ₹499; product 5 shows '49 in stock'

title: A quantity chosen on the product page reaches the cart
steps: Log in, open product 5 (Cotton T-Shirt, ₹499), set quantity 3, click Add to cart, then open the cart
expected: 'Added to cart.' appears, the page stays on product 5 and the badge shows 3. The cart has one row for product 5 with price ₹499, quantity 3 and line total ₹1,497; subtotal ₹1,497; header shows '3 item(s)'

title: Adding to the cart does not change the stock shown
steps: Log in, open product 10 (2 in stock), add 1 to the cart, then reload the page
expected: Before and after the reload the page shows '2 in stock' and Add to cart stays enabled; the badge shows 1

title: A product added from its card shows on the cart page and links back
steps: Log in, add Wireless Earbuds (product 7, ₹1,999) from All products, open the cart, click the product name
expected: Cart row shows 'Wireless Earbuds', ₹1,999, quantity 1, line total ₹1,999 and a Remove button; subtotal ₹1,999. The name opens the Wireless Earbuds product page
